up: For all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4725214, return the canonical SMILES, the molecule ChEMBL ID, and the exact activity values. Use the canonical_smiles from compound_structures, chembl_id from molecule_dictionary, and standard_value from activities.
sql:
SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id,
  a.standard_value
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE a.assay_id = (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4725214')
  AND a.standard_relation = '=';
